recorder.pane.title: Screen recorder
recorder.strip.title: Recording controls
recorder.strip.size-hint: The written size does not stream while the recording runs; it arrives once the recording ends.
recorder.mini.title: Recording controls, compact
recorder.mini.drag-hint: Drag the bar by its counter
recorder.mini.in-frame: No region is selected, so the compact bar has nowhere outside the frame to sit and will appear in the recording.
recorder.target.title: What to Record
recorder.target.window-title-hint: The title as the window bar writes it
recorder.target.region-hint: Width and height both have to be even numbers.
recorder.option.title: Recording options
recorder.option.quality-hint: CRF value; a smaller number leaves a bigger file
recorder.audio.title: Sound
recorder.audio.hint: Choosing both records two inputs and mixes them into one track.
recorder.output.title: Output folder
recorder.output.partial: Recording did not close cleanly. The file is saved and can be played. The last seconds may be missing.
recorder.output.partial-broken: Recording did not close cleanly. The file cannot be played. Choose MKV for the next recording.
recorder.error.invalid: These settings do not allow a recording: {0}
recorder.error.window-wayland: Window capture is not supported in a Wayland session; choose screen or region, or sign in to an X11 session.
recorder.error.window-missing: The window "{0}" was not found; refresh the list and choose it again.
recorder.error.folder: The folder could not be chosen: {0}
recorder.error.audio: The sound input could not be prepared: {0}
recorder.auto.manual: I will pick the settings myself
recorder.auto.manual-hint: The encoder, frame rate and quality controls open and you pick them.
recorder.budget.hint: Give both and the recording aims for that size; leave them empty and the program picks the best settings.
recorder.budget.too-small: The target is too small; video needs at least {0}.
recorder.budget.invalid: Length and size must be numbers greater than zero.
recorder.auto.trials: {0} candidates tried; the winner dropped {1} frames.
recorder.auto.unmeasured: No trial recording could run; the first candidate on the ladder was written.
recorder.auto.note.refresh: frame rate from the display refresh rate
recorder.auto.note.container: mkv container: a killed recording stays playable
recorder.auto.note.preset: preset from the encoder's own vocabulary
recorder.snapshot.failed: The snapshot could not be taken.
recorder.output.trim-none: No idle part longer than two seconds was found.
recorder.output.trim-failed: Idle parts could not be trimmed: {0}
recorder.option.live-preview-hint: While recording, shows a small frame under the strip once a second. It does not run together with a size limit.
recorder.replay.label: Replay buffer
recorder.replay.hint: While the buffer is on, the screen is written in the background to rotating parts on disk; F11 or the button saves the last seconds to the recording folder. Only the newest parts are kept.
recorder.replay.running: Replay buffer is on: F11 saves the last {0} seconds.
recorder.replay.failed: The buffer could not be saved: {0}
recorder.level.simple-hint: Only the source, audio and Start. The program picks the encoding settings.
recorder.level.advanced-hint: Every setting: target size, encoder, frame rate, output folder.
recorder.auto.automatic: Let the program pick the settings
recorder.auto.automatic-hint: The program picks the encoder, frame rate and quality with a short trial on this machine.
recorder.countdown.title: Countdown
recorder.countdown.hint: After you press Start the recording begins this many seconds later; the count shows on the strip and the compact bar.
recorder.hotkey.taken: Global shortcut is taken by another application: {0}. These keys only work while the VidShrink window is in front.
recorder.advanced.title: Advanced encoding
recorder.advanced.scale-hint: Leave empty to keep the captured size.
recorder.budget.duration-only: Recording stops by itself after {0} seconds.
recorder.budget.size-only: Recording stops by itself when it reaches {0} MB.
recorder.output.open-when-done: Open the folder when recording ends
recorder.discarded: Recording discarded; the file was deleted.
recorder.target.region-draw-hint: Drag to select the area; Esc cancels.
recorder.webcam.title: Webcam
recorder.webcam.hint: The camera picture is placed in the chosen corner of the recording. The list refreshes together with the audio list.
recorder.webcam.background.label: Camera background
recorder.webcam.background.hint: Background removal works with a static background or a green screen; step out of the frame before recording starts so the first frame sees the empty background.
